seal.statement: Partition-key ordering preserves all A1-v7 routing and split/merge hardening while closing the post-attempt consumer gaps: KeyRangeManager ID-only partition lists remain valid for split evaluation without entering row-based fallback adjacency; coalesced evaluation context is a bounded stable union that never erases existing diagnostics and always preserves reactive write_activity; numeric-TEXT detection uses a RegExp exec intrinsic captured at module load; split routing rejects Proxy metadata and Proxy target-ID arrays before descriptor traps can run; and all v7/v6 SQLite-BINARY, numeric/TEXT, typed refusal, own-data, prototype-pollution, captured-intrinsic, table-ID and row-field semantics remain unchanged.
